text:
Ruth (ML Eng): FYI Velox Labs sent invoice INV-VX-77 for $9,720 dated 2026-03-24. Coupa routed it to the wrong approver (sales) and it timed out. We need this on a short timeline for project infra. @Aisha can you re-route?
Aisha - Procurement: Thanks Ruth. Can you confirm the PO? The invoice lists PO VEL-900 but that doesn't exist in our active POs. Velox, can you attach the invoice PDF and confirm the requestor?
Velox Billing: Link: https://billing.velox.example/inv/INV-VX-77. PO field shows VEL-900 (legacy onboarding). Requestor listed: Ruth Park. We can reissue under a new PO if provided.
Leo (Finance): Without a valid PO it won't auto-approve. Two options: (1) procurement create a PO and vendor reissue invoice, or (2) get written approval from Eng owner + CFO signoff for manual payment. What's the GL and project code?
Ruth (ML Eng): Project PRJ-842 (Retriever) GL 5205. This is urgent because infra is scheduled to scale tomorrow. We can take a provisional payment if needed.
POBot: Checking legacy PO namespace... VEL-900 -> FOUND: PO_LEG_V900 assigned 2025-09-11, status ARCHIVED. Owner: Aisha - Procurement. Recommend reopen as PO-2026-510 and link legacy ref.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll reopen and create PO-2026-510 within the hour and link legacy ref. Velox, please hold until we confirm new PO and reissue invoice.
Velox Billing: We can reissue same-day with PO-2026-510 once provided. Note: bank cutoff for same-week processing is Thursday.
Leo (Finance): Given the timing, CFO pre-approval needed for provisional release. Samir, can you sign off on provisional up to $8,000 so vendor doesn't hit cashflow issues? We'll hold remainder until invoice/PO reconciled.
Samir (CFO): Approved provisional up to $8,000 for operational continuity. Finance to mark memo "provisional - legacy PO reissue pending". The remainder $1,720 to be held pending corrected invoice with PO-2026-510 and GRN or written confirmation from Ruth.
Ruth (ML Eng): I'll email my approval and attach the provisioning ticket TKT-842-3 confirming services. Uploaded to Coupa.
Aisha - Procurement: PO-2026-510 created and linked to PO_LEG_V900. Sending PO number to Velox now.
Velox Billing: Reissued invoice INV-VX-77-R with PO=PO-2026-510 and same line items. Uploaded to portal.
POBot: PO-2026-510 status: OPEN and linked to legacy ref.
Leo (Finance): Received corrected invoice. Queuing provisional payment per CFO signoff. Holding $1,720 until GRN/TKT confirmation matched.
Samir (CFO): Note for audit: exception logged for timeline-sensitive infra spend; procurement to update onboarding docs to prevent misrouted invoices.
Ruth (ML Eng): Confirmed GRN matches. Please release remaining hold when processed. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
